actions.name: curve with left wheel 10 %, right wheel 40 %
curve with left wheel 40 %, right wheel 10 %

control_flow: avoidWalls: if LLIGHT < 70, then if an obstacle is on the left turn left 20°, else if one is on the right turn right 20°, else call driveInTheDark; if LLIGHT is not below 70, call driveInTheDark.
driveInTheDark: if LLIGHT < 70 drive forward at 30 % without end, else call stopAtWall.
stopAtWall: if an obstacle is ahead, stop, else call followLine.
followLine: if the line tracker sees black curve 10/40, else curve 40/10.

likely_intent.description: In a dark bending tunnel, turn away from a wall that comes close on the left or on the right, and get through the bend without touching the tunnel.

decision_points.condition: LLIGHT is below 70 % (it is dark, as inside a tunnel)

branches.outcome: dark: it checks the side sensors

decision_points.condition: in the dark: first an obstacle on the left, second one on the right

branches.outcome: an obstacle on the left: it turns left 20°
no obstacle on the left, one on the right: it turns right 20°
nothing on either side: it calls driveInTheDark, which drives forward
dark: it drives forward at 30 % without end

decision_points.condition: an obstacle is ahead (FRONT), in bright light

branches.outcome: black: it curves with the left wheel at 10 % and the right at 40 %
no black: it curves with the left wheel at 40 % and the right at 10 %

scenarios.coded_response: With a wall on its left it turns left by 20° at 30 %, with a wall on its right it turns right by 20°: it turns towards the wall. With no wall close it drives straight on at 30 %.
scenarios.initial_condition: In a tunnel, in the dark, on a straight part 25 cm or more before a bend, where the tunnel's wall will come close on the left (the tunnel bends right) or on the right (the tunnel bends left).
scenarios.trigger: The robot reaches the bend and the left or the right obstacle sensor sees the wall.
scenarios.title: Steers away from the walls of a dark bending tunnel
assumptions: The bend brings the tunnel's wall in front of the robot's left or right half, so the side sensor sees it.
The far side of the bend is where the robot should get to.
scenarios.expected_response_hypothesis: It turns away from the close wall, right for a wall on the left and left for a wall on the right, and gets through the bend without touching the tunnel.

scenarios.coded_response: It curves left (left wheel 10 %, right 40 %) on black and right (left wheel 40 %, right 10 %) off black.
scenarios.initial_condition: In bright light, on a line, out in the open.
scenarios.trigger: The line tracker sees black, then the floor, again and again.
scenarios.title: Follows a line in bright light

scenarios.coded_response: It stops while the wall is ahead.
scenarios.initial_condition: In bright light, with a wall across the robot's way ahead.
scenarios.trigger: The front obstacle sensor sees the wall.
scenarios.title: Stops at a wall ahead in bright light

uncertainties: The program turns left when the left wall is close and right when the right wall is close, the opposite of what the sentence asks.
The side sensors are read only in dim light; in bright light the program stops at a wall ahead and otherwise follows a line, which the sentence doesn't mention.
In the dark the program drives straight on at 30 % and ignores the line.
It turns in steps of 20°, so whether it gets through a bend depends on the bend's shape.
A tunnel's wall is seen only in a bend, where the outer wall comes in front of the robot's left or right half.
